params.baseInstructions: Complete the supplied mathematical task using only its explicit inputs and tools. Submit the requested JSON artifact through structured submit_draft (preferred) or the compatible submit_artifact wrapper. Tool feedback is real task feedback; do not invent a successful check. This is a Yui workflow stage. Read the relevant declared Yui rules, preserve the supplied proof route and exact allowed assumptions, and distinguish mathematical review from structural checks.

dynamicTools.name: search_mathlib
dynamicTools.description: 在固定 mathlib 的 Lean 源码中搜索正则表达式，返回至多 100 行。

dynamicTools.name: read_mathlib
dynamicTools.description: 读取固定 mathlib 中一个 Mathlib/...lean 文件的指定行。

dynamicTools.name: read_task_input
dynamicTools.description: Read an explicitly frozen task document by ID; no other local files are accessible.

dynamicTools.name: read_yui
dynamicTools.description: Read declared Yui rules/templates; no tests, historical runs or personal files.

dynamicTools.name: check_artifact
dynamicTools.description: Check a JSON artifact against the explicit stage contract; this is not automatic mathematical certification.

dynamicTools.name: submit_artifact
dynamicTools.description: Submit a JSON artifact after its stage checks.

dynamicTools.name: report_obstacle
dynamicTools.description: Report exact status, location, explanation, basis, partial_progress. SUBSTANTIVE_GAP or SUSPECTED_GAP stops for an actual unsupported mathematical implication; give its premises, conclusion and mathematical grounds. SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or INPUT_CONFLICT stops for a real source-access/original-input obstacle. Ordinary unfinished drafting, source registration or format work must use TASK_INCOMPLETE: this records progress without ending the stage; continue the actual work. Difficulty or artifact incompletion alone is not a mathematical gap.

dynamicTools.name: check_draft
dynamicTools.description: Preferred structured-object form of check_artifact: provide artifact as an actual JSON object, not an escaped JSON string. Same complete validation and acceptance scope.

dynamicTools.name: submit_draft
dynamicTools.description: Preferred structured-object form of submit_artifact: provide artifact as an actual JSON object, not an escaped JSON string. Same complete validation and acceptance scope.

dynamicTools.name: check_lean_types
dynamicTools.description: Compile a partial mathematical definition header and selected Lean type or ordinary API term expressions with explicit parameters. Never accepts a final interface or adds a proved premise.

input.text:
Author the actual Lean interface and local typed plan for the exact
accepted NL0, preserving its mathematical content and proof route. Read every
task input and relevant Yui translation/architecture/Audit B rules. No earlier
Lean proof, hidden reference type or external project is available. Only the
explicit accepted source, task and pinned Mathlib are mathematical inputs.
Submit JSON with exactly header,parameters,premise_types,conclusion_type,
representation,objects,steps,terminal,source_outputs. header starts with import
Mathlib and contains only mathematical definitions/notation/structures needed
for the representation, never a proved/assumed conclusion, helper axiom,
opaque declaration, executable metaprogram, placeholder or result hidden in a
structure field. Mathematical proof lemmas belong in typed steps for workers.
parameters is a list of {name,type,binder_kind?} defining a coherent Lean context;
optional binder_kind is explicit (default), implicit or instance. Use instance
for legitimate typeclass data such as Field K instead of broken ordinary binders.
Include
every legitimate object/field/structure prerequisite explicitly and do not
introduce stronger assumptions than source H. premise_types maps exactly each
source root H/E/M ID to its complete faithful Lean type. conclusion_type is the
full exact target, not a surrogate standard-basis/special-case problem. All
definitions, original assumptions and changes of representation must match
NL0; if equivalent representations are used, include proved conversion steps
rather than new assumptions. In particular arbitrary admissible lattices,
the scalar-extension construction, characteristic 2 and lambda=0 cannot be
discarded in the Lie exercise. Full source paragraphs and allowed root IDs
are in source-map.json. The controller copies them into the contract exactly.
steps is a list of {id:Tddd,statement:<Lean Prop>,inputs:[root/T IDs],
source_steps:[the supplied distinct S IDs],explanation:<specific implementation
route>}; include useful small closed obligations following those paragraphs.
Every retained step reaches terminal; cover every source paragraph and realize
each N/P source output in source_outputs:{sourceID:TID}. The terminal type is
exactly conclusion_type. objects is a list of optional v2 object/view records
as in Yui architecture; an empty list is permitted if no special views are used.
representation is a detailed string explaining actual domains, scalar fields,
objects, and encodings, not a claim of semantic approval. check_artifact returns
real structural/type elaboration feedback in the isolated Lean sandbox. Repair
typing mistakes without changing the theorem or assuming missing results.
Build and check the representation incrementally: search actual Mathlib APIs,
then use check_lean_types on an incomplete definition header and selected
parameter/type expressions before submitting the whole interface. This probe
never accepts an interface, proves a lemma, or adds a premise. Do not wait until
the whole lattice/tensor encoding is perfected before trying concrete types.
No Lean proof is required in this authoring stage; every mathematical step is
an unproved obligation for later workers. A type-check pass requires an actual
separate source-fidelity/interface review before freeze and proof execution.

Bounded repair: read prior-interface.json and actual-interface-review.json. Verify every review claim against the exact original NL0. H004 explicitly says "V(lambda) is the complex irreducible highest-weight sl2-module"; characteristic-zero irreducibility is a legitimate source assumption, so the review's allegation that this particular fact is new is contradicted by the actual source. Preserve the full real H001-H004 content and arbitrary lattice; do not appease a mistaken finding by changing the problem. The genuine defects remain: the source-facing target is M tensor_Z K, and a comment about a commutor is not an actual conversion obligation. Use the original tensor order directly or prove explicit closed typed transport ports, ending in exactly the original-order target. T001-T007 as True or forall-index-True are vacuous placeholders; do not submit them as basis, matrix-unit or lattice conclusions. Supply actual formulas or retain fewer genuinely substantive ports instead of inventing superficial granularity. Fixed outer parameters do not force a witness to become a new global assumption: existential outputs may be followed by universally quantified conditional ports over any witness satisfying the preceding property, with actual witnesses chosen/discharged in final assembly. A named Prop definition can express such a formula with the proper local instances, but cannot assume/prove the helper result in an input field. Follow the already supplied mathematical route and exact paragraph mapping. Partial type/term probes are available; no earlier Lean reference proof is supplied. Return a source-faithful actual typed interface/plan for a new independent review.
Yui entry: read_yui(path="SKILL.md", start=1, end=200). Available frozen rule paths (relative to rigorous-proof): SKILL.md, references/audit-a.md, references/external-theorems.md, references/isolation.md, references/lean-handoff.md, references/logical-rules.md, references/measurement.md, references/nl0-authoring.md, references/nl0-format.md, references/nl0-stage.md, references/self-containment.md, templates/audit-a.md, templates/authoring.md, templates/submission-example.md, translation/references/architecture.md, translation/references/audit-b.md, translation/references/design-notes.md, translation/references/experiments.md, translation/references/integrated-workflow.md, translation/references/obstacle-routing.md, translation/references/shared-lemmas.md, translation/references/source-refactoring.md, translation/references/stage.md, translation/references/translation-rules.md, translation/references/workflow.md, translation/templates/audit-b.md, translation/templates/source-refactoring.md. Every read supports at most 250 lines. Start with the entry and follow its relevant links; do not guess filenames.
Frozen task document IDs: actual-interface-review.json, nl0.json, prior-interface.json, problem.md, source-context.md, source-map.json, spec.json. Use read_task_input to read them.
Prefer check_draft/submit_draft with an actual artifact JSON object. The older check_artifact/submit_artifact wrappers require artifact_json to be a double-encoded valid JSON string; do not supply Python dictionaries or single-quoted keys. Both forms run identical checks.
